decisions.reason: As a newly launched product line closely tied to the firm's core formwork systems and given prominent web presentation, it is still an unresolved but attractive option whose likely low incremental carrying cost supports keeping it.

This automation-oriented add-on fits the firm's growth direction and installed-base business, so management would likely keep it while market uncertainty resolves, though its lower visibility suggests some pruning risk if uptake is weak.
A shuttering magnet block is close to the established offer and likely inexpensive to continue offering, so its option value remains positive despite only limited initial prominence on the website.
Magnetic formwork strips are strongly adjacent to the firm's modular product base and were presented prominently, making them a low-risk extension that management would be inclined to retain.

This magnetic formwork component appears to extend the existing portfolio with limited additional commitment, and its dedicated web presence suggests the firm sees enough potential to keep the option open.

Although this component also fits the core business, its lower web prominence and possible overlap with other magnetic formwork items make it the most likely candidate for later rationalization, but not yet for immediate withdrawal.
